sections.title: Settings page content
sections.what: The Settings page shows the sports and language the user chose, a link to download their data, and the delete account form. It loads the signed-in user's preferences when the page opens.
sections.why: Likely reason: the three account controls are grouped on one page so users can find them together.
sections.watch_out: If no language is stored, the page shows English, so a missing setting looks like a real choice.
